about.title: About Me
about.description: With 3+ years of experience building cross-platform mobile applications and supporting web/admin platforms across eCommerce, transportation, logistics, healthcare, payments, identity verification, and other business domains. Skilled in translating business requirements into mobile interfaces, integrating REST APIs and third-party services, and building admin dashboards with full CRUD functionality. Primary stack is Flutter/Dart, complemented by Next.js/JavaScript, Firebase, Google Maps, and payment/identity-verification integrations. Uses AI-assisted development tools and workflows (Claude, Cursor, custom rules and agents) to accelerate delivery while maintaining strong engineering judgment.

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.description: Developed and maintained production Flutter applications for Android and iOS across eCommerce, delivery/logistics, and multi-vendor platforms, serving customer, vendor, driver, and service-provider roles. Built core eCommerce flows—catalog, cart, checkout, coupons, orders, and ratings—and contributed to admin dashboards with full CRUD functionality. Integrated Google Maps and live location tracking for transportation and delivery workflows, including driver location updates and route visualization. Integrated payment gateways including Zain Cash, handling checkout, payment status, and order-workflow synchronization. Implemented authentication, role-based access, and Firebase-backed infrastructure (auth, push notifications, app configuration). Collaborated with backend and frontend developers using Git workflows across debugging, testing, and release preparation.

experience.title: Flutter Developer
experience.description: Built and shipped an Invoice Management application and admin panel covering invoice creation, billing workflows, and payment-related data. Developed a Home-Working platform connecting freelancers and service providers with job opportunities, including role-based access and service workflows. Implemented authentication, state/data management, and REST API integration across both mobile applications. Delivered cross-platform Flutter UI with consistent performance across Android and iOS, collaborating closely with backend teams on business logic.
